dedupe_keys.name: oversvamningsportalen swedish national flood mapping portal

description: Översvämningsportalen is the Swedish national portal for flood mapping, gathering all flood inundation maps the agency has produced to support municipalities and county boards in planning, together with its geographic data under the Swedish flood risk ordinance. The maps cover river flood mapping with 100-year, 200-year and highest calculated flows, most with climate-adjusted flows for the end of the century, hazard and risk maps and flood risk management plans under the ordinance, cloudburst (pluvial) mapping, mapping for Lakes Mälaren and Vänern and the Göta and Torne rivers, and coastal flooding in decimetre steps from 0.1 to 5.0 metres. It is run by the Swedish Civil Defence agency (MCF, formerly MSB). Layers are available free to download as GIS data or as WMS services with method reports; no licence is named on the page read. Caveats: layers and scenarios differ between mappings, so each report must be checked. It gives national flood exposure layers for Swedish roads, rail, utilities and buildings; a related record is the Poland ISOK flood hazard maps.
